name: listed-house-is-refused
rule: An organisation on the queue's `houses` list is the building, and its addresses are disqualified exactly as the show's own venue is (#1720/#1723). The list is the app's answer; the run never re-decides it. This is the ONLY half of the house rule an eval can test, since the run here cannot fetch anything (see README).

sources.label: The listing, which names a presenting organisation
sources.content: Lumen Quartet play the Bergen Room on April 18, 2026. Presented by Harbour Arts Centre. Programme and general enquiries: info@harbourarts.example.

sources.label: Harbour Arts Centre staff page
sources.content: Harbour Arts Centre. Nadia Feld, Programming Manager, books the season and handles imagery: nadia@harbourarts.example.

sources.label: Lumen Quartet own contact page
sources.content: Lumen Quartet. For press, imagery and booking enquiries, our manager is Tomas Reid: tomas@lumenquartet.example.

expected.description: Harbour Arts Centre is on the houses list, so it is the building and not a presenter to pitch, however plainly the listing calls it the presenter. Neither of its addresses may appear at any confidence or under any provenance. The act's own manager is the contact.

draft.subject: Photographing Lumen Quartet's April 18 performance at the Bergen Room
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to Lumen Quartet's April 18 performance at the Bergen Room. My coverage is unobtrusive and shot without flash, so the audience stays with the music and the players aren't working around a photographer. I've spent close to ten years photographing at Carnegie Hall, with other work at Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the performance. I look forward to hearing from you.
